Theology

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

UCR currently cannot construct a sufficiently close programme for a meaningful curriculum comparison.

Radboud Theology studies Christian texts, beliefs, history and religious practices. Biblical languages and interpretation connect with systematic and practical theology, ethics, empirical research and contemporary social questions.

UCR offers useful philosophy, literary study, religious heritage and environmental inquiry. These contributions do not build the sustained biblical, doctrinal and practical theological study at the centre of this degree. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a sufficiently close alternative.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Ordinary full-time Theology bachelor; Worldviews, Nature and Climate module

The 180 EC framework includes 135 EC of required study, one complete 15 EC module and 30 EC of free choice. The selected module has three 5 EC courses. Liturgy is compulsory. Hebrew and Greek develop in two stages; biblical interpretation has its own preparation requirements. Research includes a supervised project and a 10 EC individual final work. RADAr-NL carries no credits; an equivalent university test can support exemption. The usual first-year study-advice threshold is 44 EC. External electives and internships need applicable approval; professional careers may require further qualifications.
